thread:
marco: Heads up — brief idea: add an "SLO exposure" card in the tenant view that shows what percentage of alerts would surface given current quiet-profiles and sampling. Could help product teams see 'what they'd actually get' before flipping rules.
anya: nice. Would that be per-route or rolled up per-tenant? i'm thinking per-route + top-5 noisy services.
carlos: per-route + computed rollup makes sense. we should also show projected paging rate if they remove soft-hysteresis.
ux-ji: do we have space in the console for another card? maybe collapse into the existing alerts panel as an expandable detail? also want a tiny preview of 'what notifications look like' (email/Slack)
sre-liz: critical: telemetry cost. computing exact projections for all tenants is heavy. can we compute async and cache for 24h and show an 'as-of' timestamp? also sampling knobs in the UI should link to the caching policy.
marco: agree on caching. propose compute on demand for tenant when they open the card, fallback to last cached snapshot. show a warning if snapshot >24h old.
anya: UX question: how do we avoid alarming customers when the preview shows a high paging rate? maybe show toggles: "include soft alerts" and "simulate removal of quiet-profiles" so they can experiment.
carlos: Also expose a 'per-token cost delta' column — customers care about cost impact of flipping SLOs. we already have cost metrics per-route so reuse that.
marco: implementation sketch:
```
GET /api/tenants/{id}/slo-exposure?routes=top5&include_soft=true
Response: { snapshot_ts, projections: [{route, projected_alerts_per_day, projected_pages_per_day, cost_delta_usd}] }
```
sre-liz: +1 but add rate-limit and queue the compute job: if heavy request returns 202 + location for status; otherwise 200 with cached data.
ux-ji: for rollout UX: add an ephemeral 'preview mode' toggle on policy edits. users can tweak thresholds and click Preview to see pre-computed exposure delta. no commit unless they press Save.
anya: minor: surface whether the projection assumes current notify-suppression windows (quiet windows) or ignores them — add a checkbox "respect quiet windows".
marco: ok i'll draft an API RFC and a tiny console mock. will ping infra for a small batch job to generate snapshots. thanks all :thumbsup:
